protocols.name: Essay
protocols.tagline: The long-form argumentative essay, held to its own project and its author's archive.
protocols.holdYouTo: Every claim checked, the field mapped, an independent second read, a verdict.

venueBar.prompt: The author's own archive (linked voice) or a named venue — inferred from the piece, stated as inferred.

protocols.name: Academic
protocols.tagline: Journal articles, thesis chapters, and grants — held to the target venue's bar.
protocols.holdYouTo: No fabricated references; apparatus in full; abstract and keywords required.

venueBar.prompt: The target journal or committee — pick from the table or type a venue.

protocols.name: Op-ed
protocols.tagline: Short opinion pieces held to an outlet's word cap and a fast verdict.
protocols.holdYouTo: Links only; the outlet cap is the meter; a tight argument over apparatus.

venueBar.prompt: The outlet this piece is written for — pick from the table or type a venue.

protocols.name: Memo
protocols.tagline: Internal briefs and six-pagers — written to be read silently and decided on.
protocols.holdYouTo: An executive summary up front; light apparatus; the named audience's questions answered.

venueBar.prompt: "Six-pager read silently" — optionally name the audience.
